usage: deskops review dispose [-h] --verdict {accepted,rejected,incomplete}
                              --reason REASON [--root ROOT]
                              [--format {text,json,yaml}]
                              review_id

Write the verdict on one pending review receipt.

positional arguments:
  review_id             Review id (e.g. review-task-fix-thing-preflight-1).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --verdict {accepted,rejected,incomplete}
                        Disposition verdict.
  --reason REASON       Why the review is disposed with this verdict.
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
  --format {text,json,yaml}
                        Output format.

Example:
  deskops review dispose review-task-fix-thing-preflight-1 --verdict accepted --reason "..." --root .
